questions.q: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse 13 cm and another side 5 cm. Find the third side.
questions.why: For a shorter side subtract: √(13² − 5²) = √144 = 12 cm.

questions.q: The bearing of B from A is 070°. Find the bearing of A from B.
In a right-angled triangle, the side opposite angle x is 7 cm and the adjacent side is 10 cm. Which gives x?
questions.why: Opposite and adjacent give tan x = 7/10.
